APP_BASE_URL.description: Web App URL for story feedback links

STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket name for generated content

ANALYTICS_SCHEDULER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.description: OIDC service account allowed to invoke analytics reconciliation

IMAGE_ANALYZER_PROVIDER.description: Optional provider override for multimodal image analysis

FFMPEG_BINARY.description: System FFmpeg executable; defaults to ffmpeg

FFPROBE_BINARY.description: System ffprobe executable used to measure narration duration; defaults to ffprobe

TTS_EXPRESSIVE_DIRECTION_ENABLED.description: Case-insensitive true/false/1/0 (empty = false). Gemini only: per-chunk narration direction (mood styles + sparse audio tags) via a text LLM

GOOGLE_GENAI_MODEL.description: Gemini text model used for story generation.

GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION.description: Google GenAI Developer API version for Hydrogen text generation.

STORY_TEXT_GENERATION_MODE.description: Draft complete stories using the audience and chapter policy, or draft every story chapter by chapter.

STORY_SEQUENTIAL_AUDIENCES.description: Comma-separated audiences that use chapter-by-chapter drafting in hybrid mode.

STORY_SEQUENTIAL_MIN_CHAPTERS.description: Minimum outline chapter count for chapter-by-chapter drafting in hybrid mode.

STORY_WHOLE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Requested Hydrogen output budget for a whole story.

STORY_CHAPTER_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Requested Hydrogen output budget for a sequential chapter.

TTS_DIRECTION_MODEL.description: Optional Gemini text model for narration direction; defaults to GOOGLE_GENAI_MODEL

OPENAI_IMAGE_MAX_RETRIES.description: (Optional) Max retry attempts for image generation when response lacks usable image data. Default 2

OPENAI_IMAGE_EDIT_MAX_RETRIES.description: (Optional) Override retry attempts specifically for image edit operations. Falls back to OPENAI_IMAGE_MAX_RETRIES if unset

OPENAI_IMAGE_RETRY_DELAY_MS.description: (Optional) Delay in milliseconds between retry attempts for image generation/edit. Default 1500

OPENAI_IMAGE_PREFER_BASE64.description: (Optional) If true (default), URL-only results trigger retries to obtain base64 image data

BIOGRAPHER_ENABLED.description: Enable owner Biographer HTTP operations after isolated migration and configuration

BIOGRAPHER_LIVE_ENABLED.description: Enable the dedicated live gateway entrypoint

BIOGRAPHER_WEBAPP_URL.description: Trusted HTTPS WebApp base URL for admission/checkpoint/lease/snapshot

BIOGRAPHER_INTERNAL_API_KEY.description: Secret Manager shared internal Biographer service key; never browser-exposed

BIOGRAPHER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact browser Origin allowlist for live WebSocket

BIOGRAPHER_STORAGE_BUCKET.description: Private Biographer input bucket; must match the WebApp bucket.
